g.text: First four = balance checks (expect ns). Last = total communication (outcome, expected to differ).
Figure 5. Per-donor technical & compositional balance (Step 3 confound check)
Each point = one donor. Median depth trends LOWER in HFpEF (p=0.069, Cliff's d=-0.33); since detection / communication are HIGHER despite lower depth, this bias is conservative (against the finding).
Any significant balance metric is shown honestly and carried as a limitation.
